titulo: The Goatman Stood in My Headlights on Goat Hill Road | Cryptid Horror #Shorts
titulo_pt: O homem-bode ficou na frente dos meus faróis na estrada
resumo_pt: Um motorista de Maryland quebra numa estrada escura e um homem com pernas de bode e machado aparece. Anos depois ele acha um jornal de 1962 com a foto do mesmo homem, que nunca envelheceu.
descricao:
A man with goat legs, an axe, and headlights that never fade.

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Based on American folklore. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: My car died on a dark road in Maryland.
scenes.pt: Meu carro morreu numa estrada escura em Maryland.
scenes.visual: old blue sedan stalled on a dark country road at night, headlights on

scenes.text: Then a man walked into the headlights.
scenes.pt: Aí um homem entrou na luz dos faróis.
scenes.visual: tall figure with goat legs and an axe stepping into headlight beams

scenes.text: Goat legs. Hooves. An axe in one hand.
scenes.pt: Pernas de bode. Cascos. Um machado numa das mãos.
scenes.visual: close up of goat legs, hooves and an axe on a dark country road

scenes.text: Its face was pale, almost human.
scenes.pt: O rosto era pálido, quase humano.
scenes.visual: close up of a pale almost human face with yellow eyes in the headlights

scenes.text: He didn't run at me. He just stared.
scenes.pt: Ele não veio pra cima de mim. Só ficou olhando.
scenes.visual: goatman standing still in headlights, pale face, yellow eyes staring

scenes.text: Then he slammed the hood with the axe handle.
scenes.pt: Aí bateu no capô com o cabo do machado.
scenes.visual: axe handle slamming down on a car hood, dents forming, a frightened driver inside

scenes.text: I locked the doors and didn't breathe.
scenes.pt: Tranquei as portas e não respirei.
scenes.visual: young driver gripping a steering wheel, eyes wide in the dark car

scenes.text: When I looked again, he was gone.
scenes.pt: Quando olhei de novo, ele tinha sumido.
scenes.visual: empty dark road with headlights shining on the asphalt

scenes.text: I got home. Forgot all about it.
scenes.visual: young man at a kitchen table, relaxed, a cup of coffee

scenes.text: Years later, I found a newspaper from 1962.
scenes.pt: Anos depois, achei um jornal de 1962.
scenes.visual: yellowed newspaper page on a wooden table under a lamp

scenes.text: The headline was about a farmer hit on Goat Hill Road.
scenes.pt: A manchete falava de um fazendeiro atropelado na Goat Hill Road.
scenes.visual: old newspaper headline close up with a black and white photo of a farm road

scenes.text: The photo was of a man with goat legs.
scenes.pt: A foto mostrava um homem com pernas de bode.
scenes.visual: black and white photo of a goat-legged man holding an axe on a country road
close up of the photo's yellowed face and axe
goatman standing in headlights on a dark road, unchanged after decades

scenes.text: He's still waiting for the driver who hit him.
scenes.pt: Ele ainda está esperando o motorista que o atropelou.
scenes.visual: goatman staring into headlights on the road, one hand gripping the axe

personagens: the narrator is a young man in a dented blue sedan; the goatman is tall and thin, a human torso with shaggy goat legs and hooves, an axe in one hand, pale face and yellow eyes
